rows.name: 808 Sweet Sentiments
rows.notes: Instagram bio and Facebook page share the email 808sweetsentiments@gmail.com, and the Facebook page says it is located on Oahu. It sells dips, savory snacks and sweet treats, and takes gift basket orders by message or email. Plenty of Aloha lists it as a Windward Mall market vendor but gives no dates or times. No own schedule post found. No website found. Activity dates not visible in results, so still_active is null.

rows.name: A Team Treats
rows.notes: Only evidence is the Plenty of Aloha vendor list (Windward Mall market list). My searches returned only unrelated real-estate 'A-Team' results, so no handle could be tied to this business. Products and dates not stated.

rows.name: Akemis Fish
rows.notes: Listed by organizer Plenty of Aloha as a Windward Mall market vendor (listed as 'Akemis Fish'). No own website or social accounts found; the other results were review/directory sites, which were excluded. Market days and hours were not confirmed on an organizer page, so none are given.

rows.name: All Hawaiian Honey
rows.notes: Hawaii Farm Bureau market page lists it at Mililani (Sundays, special schedule 1st and 3rd), Honolulu Farmers' Market at Blaisdell (Wednesdays), Kailua Farmers' Market (Thursdays), and KCC (Saturdays, special schedule 2nd, 4th and 5th). The page references a July 2026 notice, so it appears current. Marketspread lists the vendor in Kaneohe (Windward), not East Honolulu as in the seed. It brings hand-harvested honey from Windward Oahu, Molokai and Big Island hives. No own website or social accounts found.

rows.name: All Star Dips
rows.notes: Dip Into Paradise's site carries an 'All Stars Dips' collection ('Delicious dips since 1991') with products priced and available to order. The site says Dip Into Paradise is a distribution company in Kaneohe, so this is Windward rather than Town/Honolulu as in the seed. Whether the distributor is the same operation as the market stand is inferred from the matching product line. Current market schedule not found; older schedules appeared only on review sites, which were excluded. No social accounts found.

rows.name: Aloha Crisps
rows.notes: The Honolulu Festival participant page lists this Instagram account and describes Aloha Crisps as all-natural, handmade-in-Hawaii pet treats. The page lists 2024, 2025 and 2026 festivals, with the 2026 festival held March 13-15, so I treated it as active. The island of production is not stated. I could not confirm this matches the seed's product, so please check. Not to be confused with Aloha Beef Chips (Kapolei beef jerky), which I did not link. No side given in the seed.

rows.name: Angelic Cravings
rows.notes: Only found on the Plenty of Aloha vendor list. The search returned only an unrelated Hi Cravings (acai) business, which I did not link. No own accounts located. Market days and products not stated.

rows.name: Artisan Cottage Sourdough
rows.notes: Marketspread vendor page links this Facebook page (tracking parameter removed) as where its sourdoughs are shown. The same page lists the vendor in Pearl City (central), not Windward as in the seed, though it sells at the Windward Mall market. Plenty of Aloha lists it as a Windward Mall vendor with no dates given. A separate 'Artisan Cottage Pink Sourdough Bakers' listing shares the Pearl City location; I could not confirm whether it is the same business or a separate page, so I did not link it. No Instagram or own website found.

rows.name: Ba-Le (LaTour Bakehouse)
rows.notes: Own site says its retail shop at 888 N Nimitz Hwy Ste 105 is open daily 7am-7pm. The site also lists farmers markets and retailers, including Ba-Le Sandwich Shops. The site footer links to an Instagram account but the URL was not visible, so Instagram is null. The business is Ba-Le Inc. dba La Tour Bakehouse, founded as Ba-Le Sandwich (1984, Chinatown). Based in Honolulu (town).

rows.name: Bairy Sweet Treats
rows.notes: Instagram bio lists the Kaneohe Makena St bake stand (Tue-Sun), Windward Mall Farmers Market Sundays 10a-2p, and Whiskey Smoke 808 (Wed-Sun). A Hawaii Baptist Academy profile says orders go through Instagram or bairysweettreats@gmail.com, and that it launched in August 2023. Plenty of Aloha lists it as a Windward Mall vendor. The Instagram bio is undated, so the schedule may have changed. Kaneohe, so Windward.

rows.name: Bistro Blends
rows.notes: The Honolulu Festival page lists 'Bistro Blends of Hawaii dba Balsamic Hawaii', a family-owned seller of balsamic vinegars, olive oils and Hawaiian treats at farmers markets and craft fairs statewide. The page gives no island base, website or social accounts, so Oahu and Town/Honolulu are unconfirmed. Not the same as Honolulu Bistro (Ala Moana grilled cheese), which I did not link.

rows.name: Bolohead Dip
rows.notes: Plenty of Aloha lists 'Bolohead Dip' under Windward Mall market vendors and 'Bolohead Goodies' under Kaimuki market vendors; these may be the same business but this is not confirmed. Other search results were about the Bolohead Ridge hike and are irrelevant. No own accounts found.

rows.name: Brave Hearts Bakery
rows.notes: A Honolulu Magazine article on night markets lists Brave Hearts Bakery (baked goods) at the Ko'olau Night Market at Windward Mall, second Friday of each month, 5-9 p.m. The article is about 18 months old, so the schedule needs re-checking. No own accounts found. 'Three Hearts Bakery' in Kaneohe appeared in results but is a different name, so I did not link it.

rows.name: Cakes by Emily
rows.notes: Searches turned up several unrelated 'Cakes by Emily' businesses (Washington state, Victoria Australia, Maryland, and the Instagram @_cakes_by_emily_, Facebook CakesByEmilynw and cakes-by-emily.com, none tied to Oahu). I could not tie any handle to an Oahu business, so all are null.

rows.name: Candy Grapes
rows.notes: Not searched: I ran out of searches before reaching this vendor. Nothing verified.
